not_an_adoption: This is a derived candidate contract. Nothing here is adopted by being written. HQ adoption is required.
commission_requirement: Derive the smallest lawful authority contract capable of establishing a directional temporal claim, without assuming TWO WAVES EXIST => DIRECTIONALITY, DIFFERENCE => TRAJECTORY, or TEMPORAL COINCIDENCE => CAUSE.

why_not: No adopted authority confers temporal directionality: the closed AUTHORITY_KINDS set (rawlsing_next/pre553_empirical_authority.py:25-44) contains exactly one time-related kind, TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE, whose ceiling is 'source-native effective/reference-time evidence' and whose operation binds evidence rather than ordering observations.

The historical V553 multi-wave authorization gate (data/ddm_build_copy/ddm_v553_temporal_pressure.py:750-847) is a functional ancestor but was never adopted law: its module is provisional (V553_COMPILER_VERSION 'v553_temporal_pressure_0.2_sparse'), its positive content is a scalar pressure field that HQ204/H-A forbid inheriting, and its scope was one survey family in one country at point-year anchors.
Adopted R2 law conserves the temporalisation JURISDICTION only: 'functional jurisdiction only | no required V553 node' (PYAT_R2_REGROUNDING_R1/04_FUNCTION_CONSERVATION_CROSSWALK.tsv:15).
HQ204 accepted H-A's finding that TEMPORAL_DIRECTIONALITY_AUTHORITY is unconstituted, and accepted that two waves existing do not confer it (PYAT_CONTROL_ROOM/24_HQD125_...md:248).
succession_test_result.conclusion: This is a bounded NEW authority-form candidate at an already-lawful grain, in the same class HQ204 already accepted for H-C service-source applicability. It is not an architecture reopen.

minimality_argument.why_one_kind_and_not_a_bundle: Every other required input already exists as an exact authority kind or as exact refs. The comparison law itself - which time refs may be ordered, which response/instrument/estimand/measure surface must be shared, and what a directional claim may and may not assert - has no home in any existing kind. Exactly one new kind closes it.

existing_kinds_reused.reuse: binds each anchor's source-native effective/reference-time evidence
binds the common estimand and measure/weight basis of the compared quantity
binds the governed use of the directional claim
binds semantic/source equivalence in an exact scope where the pair crosses universes
binds the uncertainty method, or the claim carries a typed-unquantified state

explicitly_not_added: no new object family for the temporal world
no automatic release, no required V553 node

contract.extends: the existing authority discipline (exact AuthorityRef + AuthoritySnapshot resolution; fail-closed; no latest/default/fuzzy/nearest selection)

required_inputs.meaning: The exact contract that names the persisting comparand. It must compose, at minimum: source family key; geography; question/coordinate semantics; response surface; instrument release; target population / risk set; estimand; measure-and-weight design. One anchor per temporal identity. It must preserve WAVE_LABEL != ORDINAL != CALENDAR_YEAR.
required_inputs.lawful_home: TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE authority + native_scope_identity_refs + exact refs; conserved historical function H01/H02/H04

required_inputs.maximum: unbounded for a chain; each consecutive authorized pair is its own claim
required_inputs.meaning: Exactly-identified, hash-bound temporal anchors. Each anchor resolves to: source universe ref, geography, canonical wave label, explicit time ref, governing authority refs, and provenance/replay root.
required_inputs.ordering_note: The sequence supplied here is NOT the ordering evidence. It is a candidate list.

required_inputs.meaning: The authorized comparison law for the anchor time refs. Permitted bases:

permitted.meaning: each anchor names an exact calendar point or bounded calendar interval under exact TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE authority; total order over non-overlapping points/intervals
within one survey family where no calendar ref is available, an authorized ordinal may order the anchors; the ordinal may not be reported as a year, a date or an elapsed duration
bounded intervals that partially overlap. Where overlap exists, no direction may be claimed for that pair
permitted.direction_claimable: only for non-overlapping pairs; otherwise typed noncomparability

forbidden_bases: equal wave labels or equal numbers across different families
a midpoint, average or interpolated time
an ordinal rendered as a calendar year

required_inputs.meaning: The exact positive authority instance that licenses the pair. Its governed material must name the shared surface and the authorized comparison law.
must_not_be_inferred_from: membership of the same survey family alone
a shared label or a shared year

required_inputs.meaning: Exact WEIGHT_DESIGN_ESTIMAND authority plus exact estimand refs. Both anchors must be the same estimand under the same measure basis. No default averaging, no renormalisation after refusal, no silent weight substitution.
Each observed quantity is an exact, time-indexed observation ref carrying its source empirical/structural fact or admission ref and its provenance. A missing observation is not a zero observation.
Either an exact UNCERTAINTY_METHOD authority ref, or an explicit typed-unquantified uncertainty state. An unstated uncertainty blocks the claim.
The directional claim is bound to one governed use and to exact target-use permissions. Another use requires its own binding.
content-addressed claim identity; exact authority snapshot refs; canonical deterministic projection; producer replay locator/reference root; no mutable selection.

typed_nonpositive_fail_closed.meaning: the pair is not comparable under any bound authority; the refusal is itself a first-class typed observation
typed_nonpositive_fail_closed.required_work: promote from the bare string at rawlsing_next/pre553_source_relations.py:54 into a real state family

typed_nonpositive_fail_closed.meaning: the authorized order is partial and the pair overlaps; no direction is claimable
the persisting comparand is not exactly composed
fewer than two anchors authorized for this pair
the two observations are not the same estimand
the two observations do not share a measure/weight basis
the response surface or scale is not comparably harmonised
an unobserved span lies between the anchors; it is preserved as unknown and is never zero, never unchanged and never filled
an interpolated value may not serve as an anchor or as an observation
the comparability authority instance does not resolve
more than one exact authority instance claims the same pair; no winner heuristic
the pair lies outside the bound authority scope
diagnostic/non-claim output; carryable, never a claim

decision_states.fail_closed_rule: Only TEMPORAL_DIRECTIONAL_CLAIM_AUTHORIZED is positive. Every other state is terminal, typed, replayable and carries its reason. No state may be silently upgraded. A nonpositive state is not evidence of no change.
new_state_families_required: TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABILITY_STATE (TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE, TEMPORAL_INTERVAL_OVERLAP_NO_DIRECTION, TEMPORAL_ORDER_UNAUTHORIZED, TEMPORAL_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED, TEMPORAL_GAP_INTERVENING, TEMPORAL_INTERPOLATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED)

claim_shape.asserts: For one governed use, the authorized scoped quantity Q changed between exactly-comparable, exactly-ordered anchors A1 (earlier) and A2 (later) by a signed amount d under one exact estimand and measure basis, with a stated uncertainty state and exact provenance. The ordered pair (A1, A2) is an authorized ordered comparison.
claim_shape.direction_rule: Direction is derived only from the signed difference on Q under the authorized order basis. A deadband, if used, must itself be bound by the comparability authority; no default deadband is inherited.

cardinality.three_anchor_threshold: NOT LAW - no adopted or historical source establishes it
cardinality.longer_chains: consecutive authorized ordered pairs may each be emitted; the chain is a sequence of relation claims, not a distinct object

asserts_not: CAUSE: no causal relation, mechanism, mediation or explanation. Causal naming would require an adopted SDTF causal-use and calibration authority plus a filled event authority; the historical event-override slot is 'reserved_not_filled' (data/ddm_build_copy/ddm_v553_temporal_pressure.py:900) and remains unfilled.
EXTERNAL EVENT: no external-event attribution. Historically external_event_claim_made was hard-coded False (:2826) and event_registry_status 'not_supplied' (:1281); the same prohibition stands.
CONTINUITY OR INTERPOLATION between anchors: an unobserved span is preserved as unknown (TEMPORAL_GAP_INTERVENING) and may not be filled.
MONOTONICITY OR TREND: two ordered points do not establish a trend, a rate, an acceleration or a trajectory.
ZERO OR NO CHANGE IN UNOBSERVED YEARS: ABSENCE != ZERO and NONCOMPARABLE != NO_CHANGE.
TRANSFER: the direction does not transfer to another source universe, survey family, geography, population, instrument release, estimand or measure basis.
ACTOR EXPERIENCE OR EFFECT: no uptake, memory, belief, orientation, desire, capacity, distress or developmental effect. This is an objective-world claim and must be zero-effect on any actor state.
TEMPORAL DISTANCE: the claim does not assert elapsed time, calendar distance or a rate unless the anchors' exact time refs authorize it and the bound authority names it.
AGGREGATION: no averaging, pooling, backfill, renormalisation or synthetic respondent.
STRONGER NOUNS: the result is not thereby a 'trajectory', 'pressure field', 'rupture', 'movement of society', 'homology', 'capital' or 'hegemony'.

structural_blocking_of_the_three_forbidd.blocked_by: the claim requires a bound TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY authority instance; the existence of a second anchor is not evidence of comparability. Anchor refs are a candidate list, not an ordering.
no trajectory object exists in the contract; longer chains are sequences of ordered relation claims, and adopted law keeps DIFFERENCE != TRAJECTORY binding.
the contract has no causal field; the claim ceiling excludes cause and external event; causal naming requires a separate SDTF causal-use authority and a filled event authority.

kept: a named authority instance is required before a multi-anchor temporal claim
at least two eligible comparable anchors
an explicit three-state outcome (authorized / probe-only / blocked) with a typed reason
separate comparability status and separate interpretation permission
direction and magnitude carried as typed labels, not as free text
excluded: the scalar pressure field and all coefficients
eligibility determined by the presence of a scalar value
the numeric thresholds and deadbands as adopted constants

must_stay_outside: V3 actor state (actor uptake, memory, belief, orientation, desire, capacity)
affected_owners_and_boundaries.world_to_f8_boundary: If a directional claim is to condition, select a source, or change possibility geometry downstream, that is a separate operation requiring its own authority (HQ204 node H-D). This contract establishes the claim, not its consumption.

residual_risks.risk: The single new authority kind widens the closed AUTHORITY_KINDS set, which validates every authority snapshot.
residual_risks.assessment: Bounded and additive. It does not change existing kinds, existing validation, or existing fail-closed behaviour, and it is the same class of bounded form HQ204 accepted for H-C.

residual_risks.risk: TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE currently exists only as a bare string in a forbidden-backfill set, so a temporal refusal can be named where no object family can produce it.
residual_risks.assessment: Bounded defect; must be fixed as part of adopting the contract.

residual_risks.risk: A caller could bind a TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY authority instance that is itself under-specified.
residual_risks.assessment: Mitigated by the required material keys above and by the existing exact-authority resolution discipline; an under-specified instance fails closed.
